VIRAGO:
I A female warrior: स्त्रीयोधी।
II
A vixen: q. v.

VIRGIN (adj.):
I Lit.:
(1) by comp.;
(2)
कौमार (f. री: rare).
II Fig.: शुद्ध (f. द्धा),
वि-: v. Chaste, pure.

VIRTUALLY:
(1) वस्तुतः;
(2) यथार्थतः (= really,
truly: q. v.).

VIRTUE:
I In gen:
(1) धर्मः, v. and vice:
धर्माधर्मौ,

.; riches alone (will be)
the
show of all v. s:
धनमेवाशेषधर्महेतुः, V. p. iv. 24.
22.;
(2) पुण्यम् (as opposed to sin.).
II
Excellence, merit: q. v.: गुणः।
III Strength,
power: q. v.: शक्तिः।

VIRULENCE:
(1) कटुता: v. Bitterness;
(2)
उग्रता: v. Sharpness.

VIRULENT:
(1) उग्र (f. ग्रा): v. Sharp;
(2)
कटु (mfn. = bitter).

VIRULENTLY:
(1) उग्रम्: v. Sharply;
(2)
चण्डम्: v. Violently.
